properties.chose: Option (c), the real fix: a session that can open a second design without restarting, so "genesis new_project_x" and "adopt <path>" run from the hub directly. Options (a) and (b) were not chosen, because both still end in a restart, which is the session-jumping the hub exists to remove. Promoted to req:a-session-opens-another-design-without-restarting. How the second design is held stays open in dec:idea-a-session-holds-several-graphs.
properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. @ajs, 2026-09-23, from the dev_reflow2 hub: "can the project hub (like this) create a new project with /genesis (I'd imagine that would require creating a folder or having the agent do something like mkdir new_project_x) or do '<path-to-adopt> /adopt' and then reflow2 creates a reflow2 design project?"

WHAT EXISTS: the pieces, but not the act. A folder with no design already gets a server that says so and creates nothing until asked (cap:latent-surface); it promotes itself in place when the person starts a design (chg:the-latent-server-promotes-itself-in-place-and-announces-the-changed-tool-list). The hub already records its children as declared, watched dependencies. What a hub cannot do is WORK in a child it just made: a session binds to exactly one graph, and the hub reaches its children only through a per-child MCP entry in its config, which a running session does not pick up.

Options, none chosen:
(a) THE AGENT DOES IT BY HAND, with what exists: mkdir the folder, start its design there (git init, then reflow2's start-design), declare it as a child with external_dependency, add a child entry to the hub's MCP config, and restart the session to reach it. Genesis or adopt then runs inside the child. CHEAPEST, and it works today, but it ends in a restart, which is exactly the session-jumping the hub trial exists to reduce.
(b) A HUB TOOL, "start a child design at <path>", that does (a)'s bookkeeping in one call and returns the config line. Moderate cost. Still ends in a restart until a session can hold several graphs.
(c) FINISH THE REAL THING: a session that can open a second design without a restart (dec:idea-a-session-holds-several-graphs). Then "genesis new_project_x" and "adopt <path>" run from the hub directly. LARGEST, and it is the same work the hub trial already names as the missing half.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, kept beside it: creating children does not break "the hub holds no design", since the child's design lives in the child. But ADOPT FROM A HUB IS RISKY IN BULK: adopt run across many existing repos is exactly where two children end up describing the same thing (req:adopt-asks-sibling-designs-who-else-has-this-before-writing-a-region), so a hub that makes adopting easy makes that duplication easier too.
properties.name: DECIDED 2026-09-23 — a hub starts new child projects through the real fix: one session opens a second design without restarting, not by-hand or a bookkeeping tool that still ends in a restart
